subject: Loading ArcGIS Rest Web service Maps as tiles in leaflet (R)

messages.author: 07beff09857fc2d4
messages.subject: Loading ArcGIS Rest Web service Maps as tiles in leaflet (R)
parts:
Hi,

I'd like to load some of the US federal data that is available as ArcGIS webservices as tiles to a leaflet map.

I think there is an issue with just bringing ESRI ArcGIS webservices right into leaflet.

It looks like there is a plugin http://esri.github.io/esri-leaflet/

I don't do a lot in javascript and I'm not sure how I'd incorporate this into an app.

Any ideas?

leaflet()%>%
  setView(lng = -93.85, lat = 37.45, zoom = 4)%>%
  addTiles()%>%
  addWMSTiles( "http://coast.noaa.gov/arcgis/rest/services/Hurricanes/AllHurricanes/MapServer",
               layers="Cat 3-5 Hurricanes Small Scale",
               options = WMSTileOptions(format="image/png", transparent = TRUE),
               attribution = "NOAA")

Thanks,

Sam

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Loading ArcGIS Rest Web service Maps as tiles in leaflet (R)
parts:
This at least works for bringing in the tiles:

library(leaflet)
leaflet() %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addTiles("http://coast.noaa.gov/arcgis/rest/services/Hurricanes/AllHurricanes/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}")

It seems to be all the hurricanes, though. I couldn't figure out whether there were tiles available for just Cat 3-5.
